spans.s: SR0326 तेजोजलम् tejojalam Aqueous humor. Transparent liquid contain in the anterior and posterior chambers of the eye
SR0325 तेजोजलाश्रितं बाह्यं पटलं tejojalāśritaṁ bāhyaṁ paṭalaṁ Cornea. The clear transparent anterior portion of the fibrous coat of the eye composing about 1/6th of its surface.
AF2264 तेजोभि इव दर्शनं tejobhi iva darśanaṁ Sees objects as fire
